# Greenhouse

> Connect Zenflow to Greenhouse to streamline talent acquisition and manage your structured hiring pipeline.

<span className="set-page-badge-native" />

<Note>
  This native integration requires a Zencoder account and is currently in **Beta**.
</Note>

## Overview

The Greenhouse integration connects Zenflow to your talent acquisition suite. Automate structured hiring tasks, track candidates throughout the pipeline, retrieve job descriptions, and streamline application reviews to improve candidate experience and hiring efficiency.

## Connecting Greenhouse

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Settings & Integrations">
    Navigate to **Settings → Integrations** in the Zenflow sidebar.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Find Greenhouse">
    Locate **Greenhouse (Beta)** in the Integrations Catalog.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Click Connect">
    Click the **Connect** or **\[+]** button on the Greenhouse card.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Configure credentials">
    Provide your Greenhouse Harvest API Key or complete the OAuth connection sequence.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Integration enabled">
    Once authenticated, Zenflow is ready to access and update candidate and job tracking data in Greenhouse.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## What the Agent Can Do

* **Jobs** — Search and list active job posts, job descriptions, and hiring team details
* **Candidates** — Retrieve candidate profiles, resumes, and application questions
* **Pipeline Tracking** — Track candidates through stages, view interview feedback, and update statuses

## Example Use Cases

* Parse newly received applications and automatically create candidate profiles in Greenhouse
* Retrieve candidate profiles and resumes to prepare comprehensive pre-interview briefing documents for hiring managers
* Update application stages and status tags as candidates move through the hiring pipeline
* Extract recruiting metrics and summarize application volume for active job roles
